title: 统一退出与快速重开

defects.D29: tray exit path did not unify stop/flush; self-update exit(0) after 500ms bypassed desktop exit; 6s disconnect grace existed but normal exit relied on a time race

dart: apps/desktop/lib/app/shell/desktop_integration.dart: runBoundedShutdown (per-step timeout + total budget, failure isolation, never throws); DesktopIntegration.runShutdown (stop_runtime -> flush_stats -> restore_platform -> stop_scheduler -> unregister_hotkeys); unified exitApp + exitForUpdate; DesktopLifecycle interface + holder type narrowed; hideOnClose pure decision used by onWindowClose
apps/desktop/lib/features/update/update_controller.dart: applyAppUpdate awaits handoffExit(); handoffExit prefers the real bounded lifecycle, falls back to injected AppExit
rust: crates/bridge_api/src/api/monitor.rs: persist_stats + #[frb(sync)] stats_flush; monitor_start_polling drains/flushes store (lock released before disk write)
services/net_host/src/session.rs: idle_exit_due pure decision + HostState::should_exit_idle; new unit test
services/net_host/src/server.rs: watchdog notifies shutdown when idle with no client/session
crates/application/src/engine.rs: reconcile_applied_session no longer falls back to the persisted desired node (or a default Xray API) on a reconnect without an apply_target

must_pass_scenarios.hide_is_not_stop: hideOnClose decision test (Windows always hides); onWindowClose only hides, never stops
must_pass_scenarios.bounded_real_exit_stop_drain_flush_resto: dart tests 1-4 (order, failure isolation, per-step timeout, total budget)
must_pass_scenarios.quick_reopen_no_residual_lease_or_proces: net_host 6s reclaim + idle_exit_due host self-termination; explicit stop_runtime before exit; engine no longer guesses desired on reconnect
must_pass_scenarios.self_update_no_old_core_lock: update_controller.handoffExit -> DesktopIntegration.exitForUpdate -> runShutdown stops core before exit(0)
must_pass_scenarios.reconnect_reports_actual_not_desired: engine reconcile_applied_session publishes applied session only with an apply_target; no desired/Xray guess
must_pass_scenarios.lost_host_is_not_normal_exit: runtime stop unknown-outcome reconcile retained (R4-04); host reclaim/idle-exit path distinguished from a clean stop via state/events
must_pass_scenarios.no_change_to_R4_01_04_contracts: implemented as additive; R4-01/R4-04 Dart/Rust tests unaffected
